metadata.case_name: NG CHI CHUNG v. LAU KAM PING

plaintiff.occupation_before: student (final year, Bachelor of Business (Marketing), Lingnan College)
plaintiff.occupation_after: research assistant (temporary employment with Lingnan College)

source: his right upper arm is paralyzed with a complete loss of sensation. His right arm could not perform any function.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple nerves at shoulder or upper arm level
Injury of unspecified blood vessels of thorax

injuries.description: crush injuries to the left forearm and left hand
source: crush injuries to the left forearm and left hand
As for the left hand, the radius was removed, plating was done to the metacarpal bone and the wrist joint was fused.

injuries.description: dislocation of the left radial head
source: dislocation of the left radial head

injuries.icd_description: Fracture of other metacarpal bone, unspecified
Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

manifestations.description: unconscious state on admission; remained unconscious until the third week after the accident
confused state for about 2 weeks as a result of sedation
paralysis of right upper arm with complete loss of sensation; right arm could not perform any function
requires shoulder immobilizer to keep the arm immobilized and in place
cannot perform pronation nor supination (wrist fused)
power grip and lateral pinch reduced to about 50 to 60% of expected normal strength
had to re-learn some daily skills such as walking, writing and feeding himself
difficulties with daily activities including getting dressed and undressed, opening and handling an umbrella, handling hair dryer and holding heavy objects
requires assistance when washing his hair and bathing
unable to undertake activities requiring coordination of both hands (tying shoe laces, squeezing toothpaste, wringing towels, dining with knife and fork)
can no longer take up swimming and ball games
multiple large, raised and pigmented surgical scars; marks from skin and muscle grafting and stitching; conspicuous and unsightly
more irritable mood and tendency to avoid crowds; reduced confidence and low esteem; risk of future crisis requiring professional assistance

treatments_future: possible operation to fuse the right shoulder and wrist
